victory.summary: Complete victory needs all three at once: 96 continuous months as the highest real authority over every inhabited region, with food, water and order holding everywhere; 24 continuous months of fleet-wide jump capability with series manufacture, deployment, replacement and crews; and two loaded jump round trips at least 12 months apart inside the last 96 months, flown during that governance. Conquest never waives the jump requirements and jump flights never waive governance. Only one seat can win.
